stories.title: SEC files suit vs. LSU over its intent to play pros
stories.summary: The SEC filed a lawsuit against LSU over the school's "unequivocal intent" to utilize players who recently participated in NFL training camps during the upcoming season.

stories.title: Lombardi resigns as UNC GM amid investigation
stories.summary: Michael Lombardi has resigned as the GM of the UNC football team, which he had joined when Bill Belichick was hired in late 2024.

stories.title: Skattebo says he mulled retiring after '25 injury
stories.summary: Giants running back Cam Skattebo said Thursday on the "Up & Adams Show" that he briefly contemplated retirement after he suffered an open fracture of his right ankle during his rookie season.

stories.title: Sanchez plans to plead guilty in '25 assault case
stories.summary: Former NFL quarterback and Fox broadcaster Mark Sanchez has agreed to plead guilty in connection to the alleged attack of a truck driver in Indianapolis last year.

stories.title: Sorsby on gambling addiction: 'A ton of remorse'
stories.summary: Former Texas Tech quarterback Brendan Sorsby expressed remorse for his history of sports betting in a new documentary series behind the scenes of the Red Raiders' turbulent offseason.
